main.headline: Order 10% extra. Here's why.
main.sub: Cuts and breakages eat tiles. Add 10%, or 15–20% for herringbone. Every tile page has a calculator.
main.caption:
Tiler's tip: never order the exact square metres.
Cuts around walls, pipes and doorways eat tiles, and the odd one cracks. Add 10% to your area, or 15–20% for herringbone or diagonal layouts.
Running short mid-job hurts: a later batch can come up a slightly different shade.
Every tile page on our site has a calculator that works out the boxes for you. Floor shown: Morgan Storm, $37.40/m².
Save this for when you measure up.
